outcome: Obstetrical complications (including preterm premature rupture of membranes)
cohort: The study participants were 378 pregnant patients undergoing fetal myelomeningocele repair identified from the Pediatric Health Information System database.
finding: Endoscopic fetal myelomeningocele repair shows a comparable rate of fetal complications and a similar in-hospital maternal safety profile to the open approach, despite an association with increased intrauterine infection.
gest_age: The endoscopic approach occurred at a later gestational age (25 weeks vs 24 weeks) compared to the open approach.
